description: On desktop, oversized working files are guarded by the actual API and switching files restores ordinary Monaco models. All selectors and expectations are given; no source exploration is needed. Generate and run the complete script, with waits and no sleep steps. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and open Diffs: click the button with aria-label exactly "Diffs" in the header's workspace toolbar (".chat-workspace-actions"). Wait for ".diff-viewer-overlay". Click its ".commit-picker-trigger", wait for ".commit-picker-popover", then click ".commit-picker-row-working .commit-picker-row-main" in that popover (desktop uses a popover, not Git Graph). The file select is the first "select.diff-viewer-select" in the overlay. Select "b-small.txt" and wait for ".editor.modified .view-lines" to contain "ordinary after". Select "a-large.txt". The panel with data-testid "large-file-panel" must be visible and contain "Too large to display", "Combined file size exceeds 2 MiB.", "Before:", "After:", and "KiB". The ".diff-viewer-editor" must be hidden. Poll an eval expecting true that every ".diff-viewer-editor .view-lines" has no ".view-line" children: any prior Monaco model must be detached, not merely hidden. The panel must have exactly one link named "Download patch". Evaluate its href as a URL: pathname must be "/api/git/file-diff/working/a-large.txt", searchParams.get("download") must be "patch", and searchParams.get("cwd") must equal "{{REPO}}"; it must have a download attribute. In an async eval, fetch that same URL with only its download parameter removed. The actual JSON response must have tooLarge === true, path === "a-large.txt", oldBytes === {{OLD_BYTES}}, newBytes === {{NEW_BYTES}}, oldExists === true, newExists === true, oldContent === "" and newContent === "". Do not mock requests. Click the "Download patch" link, then call "patch downloaded" until it returns "true". The overlay's button named exactly "Next change (.)" must be disabled. Select "b-small.txt" again. The large-file panel is hidden, the ".diff-viewer-editor" is visible and its modified side contains "ordinary after". Select "a-large.txt" again. The panel with data-testid "large-file-panel" must be visible and contain "Too large to display", "Combined file size exceeds 2 MiB.", "Before:", "After:", and "KiB". The ".diff-viewer-editor" must be hidden. Poll an eval expecting true that every ".diff-viewer-editor .view-lines" has no ".view-line" children: any prior Monaco model must be detached, not merely hidden.

steps.expression: (function() { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid="large-file-panel"] a[download]'); const url = new URL(a.href); return url.pathname + '|' + url.searchParams.get('download') + '|' + url.searchParams.get('cwd') + '|' + (a.hasAttribute('download') ? 'has-download' : 'no-download'); })()

(async () => { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid="large-file-panel"] a[download]'); const url = new URL(a.href); url.searchParams.delete('download'); const r = await fetch(url.toString()); const j = await r.json(); return JSON.stringify({tooLarge: j.tooLarge, path: j.path, oldBytes: j.oldBytes, newBytes: j.newBytes, oldExists: j.oldExists, newExists: j.newExists, oldContent: j.oldContent, newContent: j.newContent}); })()
